title: Workload quantifier & batch simulator for safe batching recommendations
creator: Anika Shah
description: Build a deterministic workload quantifier and offline batch simulator that produces safe, explainable batching recommendations (min/max batch size, coalesce timeout, eager flush thresholds) for Redwood customers. The simulator will replay real request traces, apply candidate batching heuristics, and output estimated tail latency, p95/p99 latency, token throughput, and cost delta. This ticket covers the simulator harness, feature extraction for workload fingerprints (seq-length histogram, KV-cache reuse rate, prefix-sharing ratio, request interarrival distribution), and a ruleset-based safety filter that rejects any config which risks >5% p99 latency regression for production-like peaks.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can replay NGINX-formatted request traces and produce batch assignment logs for >10 million requests
Feature extractor persists fingerprints and a 7-day rolling distribution snapshot for each workload
Safety filter flags candidate configs when simulated p99 latency increases >5% under peak replay
Recommendation output JSON contains: recommended parameters, expected cost delta, explainer heuristics, and confidence score
rollout_plan: Generate offline recommendations for 5 pilot workloads (internal) using last 14 days of traces
Shadow-apply recommendations to staging (no live apply) and collect telemetry for 48h
Canary apply to 2% of production traffic for each pilot with auto-rollback if p99 regression >5% or error rate >0.2%
Full apply only after 72h stability window and PM sign-off
comments: 2026-03-02 - AS: Initial spike finished. Proof-of-concept can replay traces and produce batch maps for single-model workloads. Observed cold-start behaviour where small bursts form tiny batches; need heuristic to avoid tiny-batch flush amplification.

2026-03-04 - DM: Reviewed PoC. Decision: add a joined heuristic 'min_effective_batch' that considers both avg tokens and p99 tokenization time. Action: implement feature extraction for tokenization time distribution by model.
2026-03-06 - PM (Rina Patel): Please ensure simulator exposes cost model parameters (gpu_token_cost, kv_cache_savings) as inputs; we need total estimated $ change for monthly billing impact.

2026-03-08 - TL (Rajiv Menon): Concern about trace fidelity. Add synthetic spike generator to stress-test safety filter and validate rollback thresholds. Also include e2e assertion for request-id mapping correctness.

2026-03-10 - Design (Maya Lin): UX note - include human-readable rationale in recommendation output: e.g., 'Increase max_batch_size to 64 to improve throughput for chat workloads with >60% prefix reuse'. This will help SREs decide on manual overrides.

2026-03-12 - DM: Implemented conservative safety filter (reject if simulated p99 increase >5% or any error spike >0.15%). Pushed draft PR and opened dashboard. Next: run against 10 internal workloads and produce recommendation artifacts for review.
notes: Heuristics under consideration: prefix_similarity_threshold, kv_reuse_ratio, interarrival_cohesion_score (Poisson vs bursty), min_effective_batch
Simulator modes: dry-run (no costs), cost-mode (inject pricing model), stress-mode (synthetic spikes), shadow-mode (mirror real-time without apply)
Confidence scoring: blend of simulation stability (variance in p99 across runs), sample coverage (percent of requests included), and heuristic alignment (how many heuristics agree on a parameter)
Safety filter policy: fail-closed for production apply (recommendation must pass both simulated SLO and spike stress tests), but allow staging-only weaker thresholds for discovery
